cases.content:
name: materialized-example
nodes:
  n:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 80
      name: web
  net:
    type: switch
  same:
    type: compute
infrastructure:
  net: {}
  n:
    links:
    - net
features:
  same:
    type: service
entities:
  e: {}
content:
  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: green
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - n
    operating_scope:
    - web
    observation_boundaries:
    - boundary
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs: []
      evidence_refs: []
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
observation_boundaries:
  boundary:
    projection_basis: p
    observable_refs:
    - nodes.n
    evidence_refs:
    - e
    redaction_policy: r
    latency_profile: l
    view_rules:
    - information_ref: nodes.n
      boundary_class: observable_resource
      disposition: observable
      visibility_basis: basis
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    observation_boundary_refs:
    - boundary
    authority_scope_refs: []
    behavior_mode: autonomous
    autonomous_execution:
      participant_implementation_ref: external.implementation
      clock_ref: clock
      progression_policy_ref: progression
      temporal_constraint_refs:
      - cadence
      action_order:
      - act
      observation_boundary_ref: boundary
      max_action_attempts: 2
      evaluation_authority:
        mode: none
    backend_feature_support_refs:
    - action_contracts
    - autonomous_execution
    - behavior_history
    - observation_boundaries
    - temporal_contracts
time_domains:
  domain:
    kind: simulated
    tick_period_seconds:
      numerator: 1
      denominator: 1
    epoch: scenario_start
    visibility: participant_visible
    description: Shared participant time.
clocks:
  clock:
    time_domain_ref: domain
    authority_kind: runtime
    authority_ref: runtime.time-coordinator
    monotonicity: non_decreasing
    supports_pause: true
    supports_reset: true
    description: Shared participant time.
time_progression_policies:
  progression:
    clock_ref: clock
    advancement_mode: stepped
    synchronization_mode: barrier
    step_ticks: 10
    reset_behavior: new_segment_zero
    replay_behavior: restore_recorded_advances
    description: Shared participant time.
temporal_constraints:
  cadence:
    constraint_kind: cadence
    clock_ref: clock
    subject_refs:
    - nodes.n
    start:
      tick: 0
    cadence_ticks: 10
    description: Shared participant time.
materialization_provenance:
  profile: raes-materialization-attestation/v1
  attestation_id: materialization-1
  authored_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-semantic/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  instantiated_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-instantiated-snapshot/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  plan_digest: sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
  predecessor_digest: sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
  operation_id: operation-1
  run_id: run-1
  recorded_at: '2026-09-14T12:00:00Z'
  boundary: post-materialization
  producer:
    name: test-backend
    version: 1.0.0
    configuration_digest: sha256:eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
    manifest_digest: sha256:ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
  coverage_profile: raes-materialization-effects/v1
  origins: []
  resource_bindings: []

cases.content:
name: materialized-example
nodes:
  n:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 80
      name: web
  net:
    type: switch
  same:
    type: compute
infrastructure:
  net: {}
  n:
    links:
    - net
features:
  same:
    type: service
entities:
  e: {}
content:
  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: green
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - n
    operating_scope:
    - web
    observation_boundaries:
    - boundary
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs: []
      evidence_refs: []
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
observation_boundaries:
  boundary:
    projection_basis: p
    observable_refs:
    - nodes.n
    evidence_refs:
    - e
    redaction_policy: r
    latency_profile: l
    view_rules:
    - information_ref: nodes.n
      boundary_class: observable_resource
      disposition: observable
      visibility_basis: basis
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    observation_boundary_refs:
    - boundary
    authority_scope_refs: []
    behavior_mode: autonomous
    autonomous_execution:
      profile: participant-autonomous-execution/v2
      participant_implementation_ref: external.implementation
      clock_ref: clock
      progression_policy_ref: progression
      work_window_refs:
      - window
      pause_window_refs: []
      observation_boundary_ref: boundary
      stochastic_control_ref: external.stochastic
      selection_strategy: weighted
      timing:
        minimum_ticks: 10
        maximum_ticks: 20
      outside_window_disposition: next_opening
      empty_eligible_disposition: complete
      action_candidates:
        candidate:
          action_ref: act
          weight: 1
      max_occurrences: 2
      max_action_attempts: 2
      evaluation_authority:
        mode: none
    backend_feature_support_refs:
    - action_contracts
    - autonomous_execution
    - behavior_history
    - observation_boundaries
    - temporal_contracts
time_domains:
  domain:
    kind: simulated
    tick_period_seconds:
      numerator: 1
      denominator: 1
    epoch: scenario_start
    visibility: participant_visible
    description: Shared participant time.
clocks:
  clock:
    time_domain_ref: domain
    authority_kind: runtime
    authority_ref: runtime.time-coordinator
    monotonicity: non_decreasing
    supports_pause: true
    supports_reset: true
    description: Shared participant time.
time_progression_policies:
  progression:
    clock_ref: clock
    advancement_mode: stepped
    synchronization_mode: barrier
    step_ticks: 10
    reset_behavior: new_segment_zero
    replay_behavior: restore_recorded_advances
    description: Shared participant time.
temporal_constraints:
  window:
    constraint_kind: window
    clock_ref: clock
    subject_refs:
    - spec
    start:
      tick: 0
    end:
      tick: 100
    description: Shared participant window.
materialization_provenance:
  profile: raes-materialization-attestation/v1
  attestation_id: materialization-1
  authored_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-semantic/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  instantiated_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-instantiated-snapshot/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  plan_digest: sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
  predecessor_digest: sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
  operation_id: operation-1
  run_id: run-1
  recorded_at: '2026-09-14T12:00:00Z'
  boundary: post-materialization
  producer:
    name: test-backend
    version: 1.0.0
    configuration_digest: sha256:eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
    manifest_digest: sha256:ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
  coverage_profile: raes-materialization-effects/v1
  origins: []
  resource_bindings: []

cases.content:
name: materialized-example
nodes:
  n:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 80
      name: web
  net:
    type: switch
  same:
    type: compute
infrastructure:
  net: {}
  n:
    links:
    - net
features:
  same:
    type: service
entities:
  e: {}
content:
  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: green
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - n
    operating_scope:
    - web
    observation_boundaries:
    - boundary
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs: []
      evidence_refs: []
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
observation_boundaries:
  boundary:
    projection_basis: p
    observable_refs:
    - nodes.n
    evidence_refs:
    - e
    redaction_policy: r
    latency_profile: l
    view_rules:
    - information_ref: nodes.n
      boundary_class: observable_resource
      disposition: observable
      visibility_basis: basis
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    observation_boundary_refs:
    - boundary
    authority_scope_refs: []
    behavior_mode: autonomous
    autonomous_execution:
      profile: participant-autonomous-execution/v3
      participant_implementation_ref: external.implementation
      clock_ref: clock
      progression_policy_ref: progression
      work_window_refs:
      - window
      pause_window_refs: []
      observation_boundary_ref: boundary
      stochastic_control_ref: external.stochastic
      selection_strategy: weighted
      timing:
        minimum_ticks: 10
        maximum_ticks: 20
      outside_window_disposition: next_opening
      empty_eligible_disposition: complete
      action_candidates:
        candidate:
          action_ref: act
          weight: 1
      max_occurrences: 2
      max_action_attempts: 2
      max_in_flight: 10
      evaluation_authority:
        mode: none
      resource_budget:
        policy_id: p
        owners:
          p:
            kind: participant
            ref: a
        fairness:
          policy: fair
          priority_class: normal
          weight: 1
          protected: false
          borrowing: none
          reclaim: none
          max_queue_ticks: 0
          starvation_bound_ticks: 1
        dimensions:
          action_rate:
            owner_ref: p
            pool_ref: pool-action_rate
            resource_kind: action_rate
            unit: actions
            accounting_mode: windowed_counter
            meter_profile_ref: meter
            limit: 10
            reservation: 1
            reset: run
            window_ticks: 10
          concurrent_actions:
            owner_ref: p
            pool_ref: pool-concurrent_actions
            resource_kind: concurrent_actions
            unit: actions
            accounting_mode: reservable_gauge
            meter_profile_ref: meter
            limit: 10
            reservation: 1
            reset: run
          storage_growth:
            owner_ref: p
            pool_ref: pool-storage_growth
            resource_kind: storage_growth
            unit: bytes
            accounting_mode: growth_counter
            meter_profile_ref: meter
            limit: 10
            reservation: 1
            reset: reconciled
          inference_tokens:
            owner_ref: p
            pool_ref: pool-inference_tokens
            resource_kind: inference_tokens
            unit: tokens
            accounting_mode: cumulative_counter
            meter_profile_ref: meter
            limit: 10
            reservation: 1
            reset: run
          image_generations:
            owner_ref: p
            pool_ref: pool-image_generations
            resource_kind: image_generations
            unit: images
            accounting_mode: cumulative_counter
            meter_profile_ref: meter
            limit: 10
            reservation: 1
            reset: run
          accelerator:
            owner_ref: p
            pool_ref: pool-accelerator
            resource_kind: accelerator
            unit: accelerator_milliseconds
            accounting_mode: lease
            meter_profile_ref: meter
            limit: 10
            reservation: 1
            reset: run
    backend_feature_support_refs:
    - action_contracts
    - autonomous_execution
    - behavior_history
    - observation_boundaries
    - temporal_contracts
time_domains:
  domain:
    kind: simulated
    tick_period_seconds:
      numerator: 1
      denominator: 1
    epoch: scenario_start
    visibility: participant_visible
    description: Shared participant time.
clocks:
  clock:
    time_domain_ref: domain
    authority_kind: runtime
    authority_ref: runtime.time-coordinator
    monotonicity: non_decreasing
    supports_pause: true
    supports_reset: true
    description: Shared participant time.
time_progression_policies:
  progression:
    clock_ref: clock
    advancement_mode: stepped
    synchronization_mode: barrier
    step_ticks: 10
    reset_behavior: new_segment_zero
    replay_behavior: restore_recorded_advances
    description: Shared participant time.
temporal_constraints:
  window:
    constraint_kind: window
    clock_ref: clock
    subject_refs:
    - spec
    start:
      tick: 0
    end:
      tick: 100
    description: Shared participant window.
materialization_provenance:
  profile: raes-materialization-attestation/v1
  attestation_id: materialization-1
  authored_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-semantic/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  instantiated_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-instantiated-snapshot/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  plan_digest: sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
  predecessor_digest: sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
  operation_id: operation-1
  run_id: run-1
  recorded_at: '2026-09-14T12:00:00Z'
  boundary: post-materialization
  producer:
    name: test-backend
    version: 1.0.0
    configuration_digest: sha256:eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
    manifest_digest: sha256:ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
  coverage_profile: raes-materialization-effects/v1
  origins: []
  resource_bindings: []

name: materialized-example
nodes:
  n:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 80
      name: web
  net:
    type: switch
  same:
    type: compute
infrastructure:
  net: {}
  n:
    links:
    - net
features:
  same:
    type: service
entities:
  e: {}
content:
  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: blue
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - n
    operating_scope:
    - n
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs: []
      evidence_refs: []
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    authority_scope_refs:
    - nodes.n
    behavior_mode: mixed-control
    mixed_control:
      semantics: mixed-control-policy-occurrence/rev1
      form: reusable-policy
      participant_ref: a
      policy_revision: '1'
      order_strategy: total-effective-order
      initial_state_ref: a
      dispositions:
        duplicate: idempotent-if-equivalent
        stale: reject-no-state-change
        revoked: reject-no-state-change
        late: reject-no-state-change
        concurrent: order-then-revalidate
        conflict: reject-no-state-change
      controller_states:
        a:
          controller_ref: self
          authority_basis_refs:
          - nodes.n
          scope_refs:
          - nodes.n
          policy_revision: '1'
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 100
          authority_status: active
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
        b:
          controller_ref: self
          authority_basis_refs:
          - nodes.n
          scope_refs:
          - nodes.n
          policy_revision: '1'
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 100
          authority_status: active
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
      permitted_transitions:
        p:
          transition_kind: proposal
          from_state_ref: a
          to_state_ref: b
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 10
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n

  profile: raes-materialization-attestation/v1

    profile: raes-sdl-semantic/v2

name: materialized-example
nodes:
  n:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 80
      name: web
  net:
    type: switch
  same:
    type: compute
infrastructure:
  net: {}
  n:
    links:
    - net
features:
  same:
    type: service
entities:
  e: {}
content:
  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: green
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - n
    operating_scope:
    - web
    observation_boundaries:
    - boundary
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs: []
      evidence_refs: []
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
    temporal_contracts:
    - temporal_id: finish
      temporal_kind: deadline
      time_domain: simulation_time
      clock_authority: clock
      event_points:
      - end
      - deadline
      description: Bound deadline.
      duration_ref: deadline
      reset_boundary: fresh-segment
      replay_boundary: fresh-evidence
      ordering_basis: shared-superdense-time
      backend_disclosure_refs:
      - timing
      shared_time_binding:
        profile: participant-shared-time/v1
        clock_ref: clock
        constraint_ref: deadline
        event_point: end
        evidence_mode: event
    backend_timing_disclosures:
    - disclosure_id: timing
      disclosure_kind: synchronization
      support_mode: exact
      description: Shared clock evidence.
      affected_temporal_ids:
      - finish
observation_boundaries:
  boundary:
    projection_basis: p
    observable_refs:
    - nodes.n
    evidence_refs:
    - e
    redaction_policy: r
    latency_profile: l
    view_rules:
    - information_ref: nodes.n
      boundary_class: observable_resource
      disposition: observable
      visibility_basis: basis
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    observation_boundary_refs:
    - boundary
    authority_scope_refs: []
    behavior_mode: autonomous
    autonomous_execution:
      participant_implementation_ref: external.implementation
      clock_ref: clock
      progression_policy_ref: progression
      temporal_constraint_refs:
      - cadence
      action_order:
      - act
      observation_boundary_ref: boundary
      max_action_attempts: 2
      evaluation_authority:
        mode: none
    backend_feature_support_refs:
    - action_contracts
    - autonomous_execution
    - behavior_history
    - observation_boundaries
    - temporal_contracts
time_domains:
  domain:
    kind: simulated
    tick_period_seconds:
      numerator: 1
      denominator: 1
    epoch: scenario_start
    visibility: participant_visible
    description: Shared participant time.
clocks:
  clock:
    time_domain_ref: domain
    authority_kind: runtime
    authority_ref: runtime.time-coordinator
    monotonicity: non_decreasing
    supports_pause: true
    supports_reset: true
    description: Shared participant time.
time_progression_policies:
  progression:
    clock_ref: clock
    advancement_mode: stepped
    synchronization_mode: barrier
    step_ticks: 10
    reset_behavior: new_segment_zero
    replay_behavior: restore_recorded_advances
    description: Shared participant time.
temporal_constraints:
  cadence:
    constraint_kind: cadence
    clock_ref: clock
    subject_refs:
    - nodes.n
    start:
      tick: 0
    cadence_ticks: 10
    description: Shared participant time.
  deadline:
    constraint_kind: deadline
    clock_ref: clock
    subject_refs:
    - action_contracts.act
    end:
      tick: 5
    description: Bound action deadline.
materialization_provenance:
  profile: raes-materialization-attestation/v1
  attestation_id: materialization-1
  authored_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-semantic/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  instantiated_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-instantiated-snapshot/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  plan_digest: sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
  predecessor_digest: sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
  operation_id: operation-1
  run_id: run-1
  recorded_at: '2026-09-14T12:00:00Z'
  boundary: post-materialization
  producer:
    name: test-backend
    version: 1.0.0
    configuration_digest: sha256:eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
    manifest_digest: sha256:ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
  coverage_profile: raes-materialization-effects/v1
  origins: []
  resource_bindings: []

cases.content:
name: materialized-example
nodes:
  n:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 80
      name: web
  net:
    type: switch
  same:
    type: compute
infrastructure:
  net: {}
  n:
    links:
    - net
features:
  same:
    type: service
entities:
  e: {}
content:
  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: green
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - n
    operating_scope:
    - web
    observation_boundaries:
    - boundary
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs:
      - e
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
    temporal_contracts:
    - temporal_id: finish
      temporal_kind: dwell
      time_domain: simulation_time
      clock_authority: clock
      event_points:
      - start
      - end
      description: Bound deadline.
      window_ref: deadline
      duration_ref: deadline
      reset_boundary: fresh-segment
      replay_boundary: fresh-evidence
      ordering_basis: shared-superdense-time
      backend_disclosure_refs:
      - timing
      shared_time_binding:
        profile: participant-shared-time/v1
        clock_ref: clock
        constraint_ref: deadline
        event_point: start
        evidence_mode: continuous
        condition_precondition_id: authorized
        observation_boundary_ref: boundary
    backend_timing_disclosures:
    - disclosure_id: timing
      disclosure_kind: synchronization
      support_mode: exact
      description: Shared clock evidence.
      affected_temporal_ids:
      - finish
observation_boundaries:
  boundary:
    projection_basis: p
    observable_refs:
    - nodes.n
    evidence_refs:
    - e
    redaction_policy: r
    latency_profile: l
    view_rules:
    - information_ref: nodes.n
      boundary_class: observable_resource
      disposition: observable
      visibility_basis: basis
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    observation_boundary_refs:
    - boundary
    authority_scope_refs: []
    behavior_mode: autonomous
    autonomous_execution:
      participant_implementation_ref: external.implementation
      clock_ref: clock
      progression_policy_ref: progression
      temporal_constraint_refs:
      - cadence
      action_order:
      - act
      observation_boundary_ref: boundary
      max_action_attempts: 2
      evaluation_authority:
        mode: none
    backend_feature_support_refs:
    - action_contracts
    - autonomous_execution
    - behavior_history
    - observation_boundaries
    - temporal_contracts
time_domains:
  domain:
    kind: simulated
    tick_period_seconds:
      numerator: 1
      denominator: 1
    epoch: scenario_start
    visibility: participant_visible
    description: Shared participant time.
clocks:
  clock:
    time_domain_ref: domain
    authority_kind: runtime
    authority_ref: runtime.time-coordinator
    monotonicity: non_decreasing
    supports_pause: true
    supports_reset: true
    description: Shared participant time.
time_progression_policies:
  progression:
    clock_ref: clock
    advancement_mode: stepped
    synchronization_mode: barrier
    step_ticks: 10
    reset_behavior: new_segment_zero
    replay_behavior: restore_recorded_advances
    description: Shared participant time.
temporal_constraints:
  cadence:
    constraint_kind: cadence
    clock_ref: clock
    subject_refs:
    - nodes.n
    start:
      tick: 0
    cadence_ticks: 10
    description: Shared participant time.
  deadline:
    constraint_kind: window
    clock_ref: clock
    subject_refs:
    - action_contracts.act
    start:
      tick: 0
    end:
      tick: 10
    description: Bound action deadline.
materialization_provenance:
  profile: raes-materialization-attestation/v1
  attestation_id: materialization-1
  authored_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-semantic/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  instantiated_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-instantiated-snapshot/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  plan_digest: sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
  predecessor_digest: sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
  operation_id: operation-1
  run_id: run-1
  recorded_at: '2026-09-14T12:00:00Z'
  boundary: post-materialization
  producer:
    name: test-backend
    version: 1.0.0
    configuration_digest: sha256:eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
    manifest_digest: sha256:ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
  coverage_profile: raes-materialization-effects/v1
  origins: []
  resource_bindings: []

cases.content:
name: materialized-example
nodes:
  n:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 80
      name: web
  net:
    type: switch
  same:
    type: compute
infrastructure:
  net: {}
  n:
    links:
    - net
features:
  same:
    type: service
entities:
  e: {}
injects:
  inject:
    from_entity: e
    to_entities:
    - e
events:
  event:
    injects:
    - inject
scripts:
  script:
    start_time: 0
    end_time: 10
    speed: 1.0
    events:
      event: 0
stories:
  story:
    scripts:
    - script
content:
  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: green
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - n
    operating_scope:
    - web
    observation_boundaries:
    - boundary
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs: []
      evidence_refs: []
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
observation_boundaries:
  boundary:
    projection_basis: p
    observable_refs:
    - content.c
    evidence_refs:
    - e
    redaction_policy: r
    latency_profile: l
    view_rules:
    - information_ref: content.c
      boundary_class: instruction
      disposition: disclosed
      visibility_basis: p
      disclosure_rule: p
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    observation_boundary_refs:
    - boundary
    authority_scope_refs: []
    behavior_mode: null
    backend_feature_support_refs:
    - action_contracts
    - autonomous_execution
    - behavior_history
    - observation_boundaries
    - temporal_contracts
    participant_inject_deliveries:
      delivery:
        participant_ref: a
        inject_ref: inject
        occurrence:
          event_ref: event
          script_ref: script
          story_ref: story
        source_item_ref: nodes.n
        result_item_ref: content.c
        observation_boundary_ref: boundary
        delivery_kind: disclosure
        delivery_policy:
          policy_ref: p
          policy_revision: p
          exposure_policy_ref: p
          audience_scope_ref: p
          visibility_basis_ref: p
          disclosure_basis_ref: p
        order_basis: orchestration-occurrence-and-shared-time
        temporal_constraint_refs:
        - window
        evidence_requirement_refs:
        - evidence
        failure_disposition: reject-no-delivery
evidence_requirements:
  evidence:
    source_refs:
    - behavior_specifications.spec.participant_inject_deliveries.delivery
    scope_refs:
    - nodes.n
    scope: delivery
    boundary_kind: delivery
    sensitivity: plain
    redaction: redact_secrets
    integrity: checksum
    retention: study_lifetime
    loss_disclosure: required
time_domains:
  domain:
    kind: simulated
    tick_period_seconds:
      numerator: 1
      denominator: 1
    epoch: scenario_start
    visibility: participant_visible
    description: Shared participant time.
clocks:
  clock:
    time_domain_ref: domain
    authority_kind: runtime
    authority_ref: runtime.time-coordinator
    monotonicity: non_decreasing
    supports_pause: true
    supports_reset: true
    description: Shared participant time.
time_progression_policies:
  progression:
    clock_ref: clock
    advancement_mode: stepped
    synchronization_mode: barrier
    step_ticks: 10
    reset_behavior: new_segment_zero
    replay_behavior: restore_recorded_advances
    description: Shared participant time.
temporal_constraints:
  window:
    constraint_kind: window
    clock_ref: clock
    subject_refs:
    - behavior_specifications.spec.participant_inject_deliveries.delivery
    start:
      tick: 0
    end:
      tick: 10
    description: Delivery window.
materialization_provenance:
  profile: raes-materialization-attestation/v1
  attestation_id: materialization-1
  authored_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-semantic/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  instantiated_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-instantiated-snapshot/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  plan_digest: sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
  predecessor_digest: sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
  operation_id: operation-1
  run_id: run-1
  recorded_at: '2026-09-14T12:00:00Z'
  boundary: post-materialization
  producer:
    name: test-backend
    version: 1.0.0
    configuration_digest: sha256:eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
    manifest_digest: sha256:ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
  coverage_profile: raes-materialization-effects/v1
  origins: []
  resource_bindings: []

cases.content:
name: materialized-example
nodes:
  n:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 80
      name: web
  net:
    type: switch
  same:
    type: compute
infrastructure:
  net: {}
  n:
    links:
    - net
features:
  same:
    type: service
entities:
  e: {}
injects:
  inject:
    from_entity: e
    to_entities:
    - e
events:
  event:
    injects:
    - inject
scripts:
  script:
    start_time: 0
    end_time: 10
    speed: 1.0
    events:
      event: 0
stories:
  story:
    scripts:
    - script
content:
  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: green
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - nodes.n
    operating_scope:
    - nodes.n
    observation_boundaries:
    - boundary
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs: []
      evidence_refs: []
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
observation_boundaries:
  boundary:
    projection_basis: p
    observable_refs:
    - content.c
    evidence_refs:
    - e
    redaction_policy: r
    latency_profile: l
    view_rules:
    - information_ref: content.c
      boundary_class: instruction
      disposition: disclosed
      visibility_basis: p
      disclosure_rule: p
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    observation_boundary_refs:
    - boundary
    authority_scope_refs:
    - nodes.n
    behavior_mode: mixed-control
    mixed_control:
      semantics: mixed-control-policy-occurrence/rev1
      form: reusable-policy
      participant_ref: a
      policy_revision: '1'
      order_strategy: total-effective-order
      initial_state_ref: a
      dispositions:
        duplicate: idempotent-if-equivalent
        stale: reject-no-state-change
        revoked: reject-no-state-change
        late: reject-no-state-change
        concurrent: order-then-revalidate
        conflict: reject-no-state-change
      controller_states:
        a:
          controller_ref: self
          authority_basis_refs:
          - nodes.n
          scope_refs:
          - nodes.n
          policy_revision: '1'
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 100
          authority_status: active
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
        b:
          controller_ref: self
          authority_basis_refs:
          - nodes.n
          scope_refs:
          - nodes.n
          policy_revision: '1'
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 100
          authority_status: active
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
      permitted_transitions:
        p:
          transition_kind: intervention
          from_state_ref: a
          to_state_ref: b
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 10
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
    backend_feature_support_refs:
    - action_contracts
    - autonomous_execution
    - behavior_history
    - observation_boundaries
    - temporal_contracts
    participant_inject_deliveries:
      delivery:
        participant_ref: a
        inject_ref: inject
        occurrence:
          event_ref: event
          script_ref: script
          story_ref: story
        source_item_ref: nodes.n
        result_item_ref: content.c
        observation_boundary_ref: boundary
        delivery_kind: intervention
        delivery_policy:
          policy_ref: p
          policy_revision: '1'
          exposure_policy_ref: p
          audience_scope_ref: p
          visibility_basis_ref: p
          disclosure_basis_ref: p
        order_basis: orchestration-occurrence-and-shared-time
        temporal_constraint_refs:
        - window
        evidence_requirement_refs:
        - evidence
        failure_disposition: reject-no-delivery
        control:
          semantics: mixed-control-policy-occurrence/rev1
          policy_revision: '1'
          permitted_transition_ref: p
          controller_ref: self
          authority_scope_refs:
          - nodes.n
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
evidence_requirements:
  evidence:
    source_refs:
    - behavior_specifications.spec.participant_inject_deliveries.delivery
    scope_refs:
    - nodes.n
    scope: delivery
    boundary_kind: delivery
    sensitivity: plain
    redaction: redact_secrets
    integrity: checksum
    retention: study_lifetime
    loss_disclosure: required
time_domains:
  domain:
    kind: simulated
    tick_period_seconds:
      numerator: 1
      denominator: 1
    epoch: scenario_start
    visibility: participant_visible
    description: Shared participant time.
clocks:
  clock:
    time_domain_ref: domain
    authority_kind: runtime
    authority_ref: runtime.time-coordinator
    monotonicity: non_decreasing
    supports_pause: true
    supports_reset: true
    description: Shared participant time.
time_progression_policies:
  progression:
    clock_ref: clock
    advancement_mode: stepped
    synchronization_mode: barrier
    step_ticks: 10
    reset_behavior: new_segment_zero
    replay_behavior: restore_recorded_advances
    description: Shared participant time.
temporal_constraints:
  window:
    constraint_kind: window
    clock_ref: clock
    subject_refs:
    - behavior_specifications.spec.participant_inject_deliveries.delivery
    start:
      tick: 0
    end:
      tick: 10
    description: Delivery window.
materialization_provenance:
  profile: raes-materialization-attestation/v1
  attestation_id: materialization-1
  authored_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-semantic/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  instantiated_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-instantiated-snapshot/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  plan_digest: sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
  predecessor_digest: sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
  operation_id: operation-1
  run_id: run-1
  recorded_at: '2026-09-14T12:00:00Z'
  boundary: post-materialization
  producer:
    name: test-backend
    version: 1.0.0
    configuration_digest: sha256:eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
    manifest_digest: sha256:ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
  coverage_profile: raes-materialization-effects/v1
  origins: []
  resource_bindings: []

cases.content:
name: materialized-example
nodes:
  n:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 80
      name: web
  net:
    type: switch
  same:
    type: compute
infrastructure:
  net: {}
  n:
    links:
    - net
features:
  same:
    type: service
entities:
  e: {}
injects:
  inject:
    from_entity: e
    to_entities:
    - e
events:
  event:
    injects:
    - inject
scripts:
  script:
    start_time: 0
    end_time: 10
    speed: 1.0
    events:
      event: 0
stories:
  story:
    scripts:
    - script
content:
  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: green
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - nodes.n
    operating_scope:
    - nodes.n
    observation_boundaries:
    - boundary
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs: []
      evidence_refs: []
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
observation_boundaries:
  boundary:
    projection_basis: p
    observable_refs:
    - content.c
    evidence_refs:
    - e
    redaction_policy: r
    latency_profile: l
    view_rules:
    - information_ref: content.c
      boundary_class: instruction
      disposition: disclosed
      visibility_basis: p
      disclosure_rule: p
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    observation_boundary_refs:
    - boundary
    authority_scope_refs:
    - nodes.n
    behavior_mode: mixed-control
    mixed_control:
      participant_ref: a
      policy_revision: '1'
      order_strategy: total-effective-order
      initial_state_ref: a
      dispositions:
        duplicate: idempotent-if-equivalent
        stale: reject-no-state-change
        revoked: reject-no-state-change
        late: reject-no-state-change
        concurrent: order-then-revalidate
        conflict: reject-no-state-change
      controller_states:
        a:
          controller_ref: self
          authority_basis_refs:
          - nodes.n
          scope_refs:
          - nodes.n
          policy_revision: '1'
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 100
          authority_status: active
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
        b:
          controller_ref: self
          authority_basis_refs:
          - nodes.n
          scope_refs:
          - nodes.n
          policy_revision: '1'
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 100
          authority_status: active
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
      transitions:
        proposal:
          transition_kind: intervention
          from_state_ref: a
          to_state_ref: b
          policy_revision: '1'
          expected_state_revision: 0
          resulting_state_revision: 1
          effective_order: 1
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 10
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
    backend_feature_support_refs:
    - action_contracts
    - autonomous_execution
    - behavior_history
    - observation_boundaries
    - temporal_contracts
    participant_inject_deliveries:
      delivery:
        participant_ref: a
        inject_ref: inject
        occurrence:
          event_ref: event
          script_ref: script
          story_ref: story
        source_item_ref: nodes.n
        result_item_ref: content.c
        observation_boundary_ref: boundary
        delivery_kind: intervention
        delivery_policy:
          policy_ref: p
          policy_revision: '1'
          exposure_policy_ref: p
          audience_scope_ref: p
          visibility_basis_ref: p
          disclosure_basis_ref: p
        order_basis: orchestration-occurrence-and-shared-time
        temporal_constraint_refs:
        - window
        evidence_requirement_refs:
        - evidence
        failure_disposition: reject-no-delivery
        control_transition_ref: proposal
        controller_ref: self
        control_authority_scope_refs:
        - nodes.n
        control_effective_order: 1
        control_valid_from_order: 0
        control_valid_until_order: 10
        control_evidence_refs:
        - nodes.n
evidence_requirements:
  evidence:
    source_refs:
    - behavior_specifications.spec.participant_inject_deliveries.delivery
    scope_refs:
    - nodes.n
    scope: delivery
    boundary_kind: delivery
    sensitivity: plain
    redaction: redact_secrets
    integrity: checksum
    retention: study_lifetime
    loss_disclosure: required
time_domains:
  domain:
    kind: simulated
    tick_period_seconds:
      numerator: 1
      denominator: 1
    epoch: scenario_start
    visibility: participant_visible
    description: Shared participant time.
clocks:
  clock:
    time_domain_ref: domain
    authority_kind: runtime
    authority_ref: runtime.time-coordinator
    monotonicity: non_decreasing
    supports_pause: true
    supports_reset: true
    description: Shared participant time.
time_progression_policies:
  progression:
    clock_ref: clock
    advancement_mode: stepped
    synchronization_mode: barrier
    step_ticks: 10
    reset_behavior: new_segment_zero
    replay_behavior: restore_recorded_advances
    description: Shared participant time.
temporal_constraints:
  window:
    constraint_kind: window
    clock_ref: clock
    subject_refs:
    - behavior_specifications.spec.participant_inject_deliveries.delivery
    start:
      tick: 0
    end:
      tick: 10
    description: Delivery window.
materialization_provenance:
  profile: raes-materialization-attestation/v1
  attestation_id: materialization-1
  authored_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-semantic/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  instantiated_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-instantiated-snapshot/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  plan_digest: sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
  predecessor_digest: sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
  operation_id: operation-1
  run_id: run-1
  recorded_at: '2026-09-14T12:00:00Z'
  boundary: post-materialization
  producer:
    name: test-backend
    version: 1.0.0
    configuration_digest: sha256:eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
    manifest_digest: sha256:ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
  coverage_profile: raes-materialization-effects/v1
  origins: []
  resource_bindings: []

name: materialized-example
nodes:
  n:
    type: compute
    services:
    - port: 80
      name: web
  net:
    type: switch
  same:
    type: compute
infrastructure:
  net: {}
  n:
    links:
    - net
features:
  same:
    type: service
entities:
  e: {}
content:
  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: blue
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - n
    operating_scope:
    - web
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs: []
      evidence_refs: []
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
outcome_interpretation_rules:
  rule:
    semantic_version: 2.0.0
    participant_scope: participant_local
    observation_point_basis: basis
    interpretation_basis: basis
    source_bindings:
    - source_id: source
      source_layer: participant_action_outcome
      ref: act
      interpretation_role: role
    target_bindings: []
    local_outcome:
      model_version: 1.0.0
      category: effect_realization
      criterion_basis: basis
      criteria:
      - criterion_id: criterion
        source_id: source
        effect_id: intended
      conflict_policy: retain_until_explicit_correction
      freshness_policy: exact_observation_cut
      episode_policy: reset_without_transfer
    evidence_refs:
    - evidence
    limitations:
    - limitation
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    authority_scope_refs:
    - nodes.n
materialization_provenance:
  profile: raes-materialization-attestation/v1
  attestation_id: materialization-1
  authored_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-semantic/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
  instantiated_digest:
    profile: raes-sdl-instantiated-snapshot/v2
    algorithm: sha256
    value: sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  plan_digest: sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
  predecessor_digest: sha256:dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
  operation_id: operation-1
  run_id: run-1
  recorded_at: '2026-09-14T12:00:00Z'
  boundary: post-materialization
  producer:
    name: test-backend
    version: 1.0.0
    configuration_digest: sha256:eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
    manifest_digest: sha256:ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff
  coverage_profile: raes-materialization-effects/v1
  origins: []
  resource_bindings: []

nodes:

    type: service

  e: {}

  n: {}

  c:
    type: file
    target: n
    path: /a
    text: a
accounts:
  u:
    username: u
    node: n
agents:
  a:
    affiliations:
    - e
    role: blue
    actions:
    - act
    starting_accounts:
    - u
    authority_anchors:
    - nodes.n
    operating_scope:
    - nodes.n
action_contracts:
  act:
    semantic_version: 1.0.0
    behavioral_granularity: atomic
    procedure_basis: Scenario-declared Coordinate intent
    realization_profile: abstract
    fidelity_claim: Portable intent only; no backend procedure, successful effect,
      or authority is asserted.
    preconditions:
    - precondition_id: authorized
      precondition_class: authority
      description: Independent authorization is required before any realization.
      support_refs: []
      evidence_refs: []
    effects:
    - effect_id: intended
      effect_class: intended_effect
      description: Attempt Coordinate against the scenario-declared subject set.
      target_refs:
      - nodes.n
      evidence_refs: []
    failure_classes:
    - authority_denied
    - target_unavailable
    - unknown
behavior_specifications:
  spec:
    semantic_version: '1'
    participant_refs:
    - a
    action_contract_refs:
    - act
    authority_scope_refs:
    - nodes.n
    behavior_mode: mixed-control
    mixed_control:
      semantics: mixed-control-policy-occurrence/rev1
      form: reusable-policy
      participant_ref: a
      policy_revision: '1'
      order_strategy: total-effective-order
      initial_state_ref: a
      dispositions:
        duplicate: idempotent-if-equivalent
        stale: reject-no-state-change
        revoked: reject-no-state-change
        late: reject-no-state-change
        concurrent: order-then-revalidate
        conflict: reject-no-state-change
      controller_states:
        a:
          controller_ref: self
          authority_basis_refs:
          - nodes.n
          scope_refs:
          - nodes.n
          policy_revision: '1'
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 100
          authority_status: active
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
        b:
          controller_ref: self
          authority_basis_refs:
          - nodes.n
          scope_refs:
          - nodes.n
          policy_revision: '1'
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 100
          authority_status: active
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
      permitted_transitions:
        p:
          transition_kind: proposal
          from_state_ref: a
          to_state_ref: b
          valid_from_order: 0
          valid_until_order: 10
          evidence_refs:
          - nodes.n
